annotations.title: PE/VC Secondaries & Continuation Funds — What the Advisor of Record Needs to Ask

description: How to evaluate a client's roll-or-cash-out decision in a GP-led continuation fund: governance questions (fairness opinion provenance, LPAC engagement), fee-clock incentives and behavioral framing for the client and the GP, and how to present triple-bottom-line and gender-lens angles as hypotheses. Written from the advisor's practice and compliance perspective.
